summary: Tests-only (red-phase) run for issue #39. Committed: byte-for-byte parity corpus fixture from viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json (algorithm_version 1, 12 scenarios), SolverParityCorpusTests (exact scorer/selection/tie parity at both scorer and solver level, corpus provenance and coverage guards), PaletteAPIClientBehaviorTests (wire-behavior pins the generated-client migration must preserve), GeneratedClientAdoptionTests (red-phase artifact tests: OpenAPI document at Sources/ColorComposerCore/OpenAPI/, swift-openapi-generator+runtime declared in Package.swift), and docs/solver-parity-corpus.md (corpus location + refresh procedure). No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so `swift test` could not be executed; the parity logic was cross-validated with a faithful Python replay of the Swift test semantics over the committed fixture: 12/12 scenarios matched exactly (scores, exclusions, earliest-index-wins selection, tie membership, tie_broke, per-scenario excluded counts). All Swift test execution is deferred to the implementation run on a Swift-capable host.

acceptance_criteria.description: Preserve existing behavior: per-server/profile color caching, offline-stale badges, cached profile fallback

verification.notes: Behavior pins committed: endpoint URLs, printer_profile_id query, trimmed bearer token, 401->unauthorized / 5xx->badStatus / undecodable->malformedResponse mapping, snake_case envelope decoding (with and without printer_profile). Disk cache semantics (per-server/profile isolation, corrupt/foreign-file misses, clear) already covered by the 60+ pre-existing ProfileColorCacheTests. Offline-stale badge rendering lives in the app target (ColorMatching/Networking/ColorCatalog.swift) and requires Xcode to execute. Execution blocked: no Swift toolchain in this container.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add a solver parity test target in ColorComposerCore tests that loads the committed corpus and asserts WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections match expected outputs exactly, including tie cases

verification.notes: Parity tests committed: exact per-candidate score equality (corpus values are exact binary fractions), earliest-index-wins selection, best error, tie membership and tie_broke flag, solver fast-path replay via single-cell grids, corpus provenance contract (scorer/selection/missing_policy/algorithm_version/light-source order), and coverage guards (ties, three-way ties, candidate/target exclusions, all-excluded, zero-weight channels, unknown weight keys, exact match). Cross-validated with a faithful Python replay of the Swift semantics over the committed fixture: 12/12 scenarios, 0 mismatches. swift test execution deferred to a Swift-capable host.
